changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Survey') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Survey]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [SurveyTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [ResourceID] [int] NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_Survey_Uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, AssetID bigint not null, CONSTRAINT [PK_Survey] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Survey_SurveyType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Survey] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Survey_SurveyType] FOREIGN KEY([SurveyTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[SurveyType] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Survey] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Survey_SurveyType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Survey_AssetID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_Survey_AssetID ON [dbo].[Survey] ( [AssetID] ASC ) END
